description: Returns longbook's llms.txt — the contract and working method for an AI using longbook — whole, or one chapter by name. Chapters: what-longbook-is, data-minimization-rule, three-doors, first-run, working-method, prompts, importing-statements, past-is-stored-the-future-is-written, tags, categorise-my-longbook, people-and-accounts, documents-folder, document-invoices, notes, reading-reports, month-report, create-a-report, leaving-insights, unattended-runs, daily-email-round, shape, past-is-evidence, invariants, rules-for-anything-that-writes. "importing-statements" covers importing, "reading-reports" report questions, "unattended-runs" scheduled runs, "daily-email-round" the morning look at the owner's mail. Given one of longbook's 26 prompts — by its name (set-up-my-longbook, add-my-statement, categorise-my-longbook, add-a-month-report-in-my-longbook, add-email-invoices-in-my-longbook, set-up-a-daily-longbook-email-round, add-document-invoices-in-my-longbook, add-a-commitment-or-an-expense, what-do-i-pay-next, what-is-coming-in-the-next-30-days, what-did-i-spend-in-a-month, what-renews-this-year, make-my-weekly-longbook-page, create-a-report-in-my-longbook, make-a-report-of-my-trip, tidy-my-longbook, set-up-a-morning-brief, find-subscriptions-from-my-email, find-expenses-from-my-email, find-invoices-from-my-email, find-insurances-from-my-email, find-purchases-from-my-email, find-bills-from-my-email, find-loans-and-emis-from-my-email, find-travel-bookings-from-my-email, find-money-in-from-my-email) or the owner's own words for it, a month's name and all ("Add September month report in my longbook") — it returns that prompt's procedure, with the chapter it builds on. A partial name finds its chapter.
name: read_guide
